lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\Stackiq\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

4 timed jobs do not say whether they are time sensitive. A job that sets TIME_INSENSITIVE with setTimeSensitivity() is moved to the maintenance window of the server; whether a job is heavy enough for that only its maintainer knows.
lib/ reads the clock directly in 54 places. OCP\AppFramework\Utility\ITimeFactory, a PSR-20 ClockInterface, gives the same time and can be replaced in a test.

The app reads and writes its app config in 236 places and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.
2 public methods of controllers are reached by no route.
